BuilderHop.title: BuilderHop
BuilderHop.description:
One ordered hop of a `BuilderSpec`. The direction is relative to the
previous node: "out" continues with `(prev)-[:R]->(next)`, "in" with
`(prev)<-[:R]-(next)`. `temporal_qualifier` restricts the hop's
relationship to the current interval (`currently()`), a validity
instant (`as_of`), or a belief instant (`as_believed`), each of which
needs the matching `temporal_instant`.

BuilderSpec.title: BuilderSpec
BuilderSpec.description:
The structured query the builder constructs (Doc 2 §6): a starting
type with property filters plus an ordered hop list. The API rejects
any spec whose relation is not permitted between adjacent types, making
an invalid query unrepresentable rather than merely rejected (AC-24).

CoverageRequest.title: CoverageRequest
CoverageRequest.description: Either a relation set or a query — exactly one must be supplied.

CypherQuery.title: CypherQuery
CypherQuery.description:
An operator-supplied query. `params` are the query's Cypher
parameters; they travel as parameters end-to-end and never reach query
text.

EdgeRef.title: EdgeRef
EdgeRef.description:
One relationship as returned to the UI, carrying the full §5.6
assertion metadata — provenance and bitemporal interval included, so
the provenance panel (WP-36) has everything client-side (AC-28).

EnrichmentSelection.title: EnrichmentSelection
EnrichmentSelection.description:
An operator-reviewed mapping; evidence is retained in every acquisition manifest.

Symbol and exchange identify a listing, never the canonical corporation.
Security/share-class identity is optional and must be reviewed separately.

EntityRef.title: EntityRef
EntityRef.description:
One entity as returned to the UI: identity, label, concrete type,
its remaining properties, and the loader's stamps.

EvaluationReview.title: EvaluationReview
EvaluationReview.description: Human annotation of acquired evidence; never an automatic truth label.

GraphResult.title: GraphResult
GraphResult.description:
The normalized result of one executed query: deduplicated nodes and
edges plus counts. `counts["rows"]` is the raw row count — a query can
return scalar rows with no nodes, and the saved-query result count
(AC-30) records rows, not nodes.

IdentityReview.title: IdentityReview
IdentityReview.description: An operator's explicit, evidence-backed canonical identity decision.

LedgerEntryView.title: LedgerEntryView
LedgerEntryView.description: One ledger entry as returned to the operator.

LedgerView.title: LedgerView
LedgerView.description: The ledger for one period: total spend and entries.

NeighborResponse.title: NeighborResponse
NeighborResponse.description: The entity and its one-hop neighborhood.

NeighborRow.title: NeighborRow
NeighborRow.description:
One hop of the neighborhood expansion: the edge with its full
provenance and the neighbor node.

NlQuestion.title: NlQuestion
NlQuestion.description: A natural-language question for the four-stage service.

QueryResponse.title: QueryResponse
QueryResponse.description:
One executed query: the (validated) Cypher, the normalized result
graph, the coverage report, the empty-result diagnosis when applicable,
and any partial-verification notes.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description:
The latest ingestion run for one source, with the source's last
success timestamp alongside.

SavedQueryCreate.title: SavedQueryCreate
SavedQueryCreate.description:
An operator-created saved query. The auto-persisted per-execution
writes (FR-14) flow through `persist` instead and are not operator
input.

SavedQueryView.title: SavedQueryView
SavedQueryView.description: One saved query as returned to the UI.

SearchHit.title: SearchHit
SearchHit.description:
One full-text hit: the index it came from, the entity id or document
content hash, a display label, and the score.

SourceView.title: SourceView
SourceView.description:
One registered source: the registry's declarations plus the graph's
last-refresh state. `last_success_at` is null for a source that has
never run.
